scope: Retrospective development method and parameter specification, not historical publication-time or live-readiness certification

FIRST_COURSE_1_TO_6.prediction_course: D-1 Dirichlet(1)-smoothed venue by boat_no to actual_course frequencies; weighted rating score then six-boat softmax

EXACT_SECOND_COURSE_1_TO_6.prediction_course: same D-1 course mixture; separate six-boat softmax

OVERALL.update: exp-logistic pairwise Elo, 15 valid pairs divided by 15 per strict race; all D deltas from D-1 state
OVERALL.probability_diagnostic: six-boat first softmax and Plackett-Luce exact-second marginal

SHORT_50.window: maximum 50 prior STRICT eligible numeric-finish results per player, excluding every D result
SHORT_50.value: 1000 + 100 times mean of (3.5 - original_finish_position) / 2.5 in the window
SHORT_50.fewer_than_50: use only available prior valid results; with zero use the series initializer
SHORT_50.status: frozen as a rating feature definition; standalone predictive value does not establish incremental value in a later multifeature model

eligibility.selected: STRICT for A, B, and SHORT_50 numeric updates
eligibility.strict: RESULT_RECORDS_PRESENT; six canonical results; six unique NUMERIC_VALID finishes; no unresolved; for course updates actual_course is a permutation of 1..6
eligibility.row_safe: B pairwise-only candidate tested, not selected because its small improvement over STRICT did not justify a broader update population
eligibility.partial: UNSUPPORTED; no pseudo rank for special, F, or L boats

initialization.historical_warmup: Use eligible 2017-01-01 through 2022-12-31 results only to build the 2023-01-01 D-1 state
initialization.confirmed_newcomer: For every series use the pre-insertion mean of existing players with an effective rating times 0.8; same-day confirmed newcomers share that frozen mean
initialization.newcomer_uncertain: No 0.8 discount; use ordinary unknown-player initializer until eligible history is available
initialization.non_newcomer: Previously observed players retain their result-derived D-1 state; no newcomer reinitialization
initialization.short_initial_value_replacement: First eligible STRICT result replaces the SHORT_50 initializer under AVAILABLE_HISTORY; until then the assigned initial value persists

daily_boundary: All predictions on D use one immutable D-1 result-derived state; compute all D update deltas from that same state and apply after D. Actual course of a race is never its own prediction input.

versions_and_hashes.post_run_branch_note: Only the previously unexercised CONFIRMED_NEWCOMER SHORT_50 initializer branch was added after the v2 run; runtime confirmed count was zero and its behavior is covered by a targeted test. All observed-case comparison paths are unchanged.

limitations: Historical result publication timestamps and as-of availability are unverified; D-1 date ordering is mechanically verified but does not certify live readiness.
2017 is left-truncated; first observed entry is not proven career debut.
No 2023-2024 confirmed newcomer exercised the conditional 0.8 rule in the real-data comparison.
All reported predictive metrics are conditional on complete six-boat numeric-finish races; F/L and other special-outcome calibration is not established.
A mixes player course ratings using a historical pre-race course estimator and is not a pure racer-strength ablation or an exact probability marginal over courses.
The SHORT_50 standalone diagnostic is weak; incremental value alongside the other 13 series remains untested.
No production rating-state migration or 2025 performance evaluation is included.
revision_rule: After any 2025 outcome performance is inspected, do not change this v1; all later changes require v2 with a new evaluation protocol.
